世.english: surname Shi; life; age; generation; era; world; lifetime; epoch; descendant; noble

也.english: surname Ye; also; too; as well; (not ...) either; (used after a verbal or nominal expression X to indicate that X is an extreme or unexpected case) even (X); (literary) particle having functions similar to 啊[a5]

開.english: to open (transitive or intransitive); (of ships, vehicles, troops etc) to start; to turn on; to put in operation; to operate; to run; to boil; to write out (a prescription, check, invoice etc); (directional complement) away; off; carat (gold); abbr. for Kelvin, 開爾文|开尔文[Kai1 er3 wen2]; abbr. for 開本|开本[kai1 ben3], book format

升.english: to ascend; to rise; to promote; to elevate; liter; unit of dry measure for grain (= one liter or one-tenth dou 斗[dou3])

區.english: surname Ou; area; region; district; small; distinguish; CL:個|个[ge4]

道.english: road; path (CL:條|条[tiao2],股[gu3]); (bound form) way; reason; principle; (bound form) a skill; an art; a specialization; (Daoism) the Way; the Dao; to say (introducing a direct quotation, as in a novel); (bound form) to express; to extend (polite words); classifier for long thin things (rivers, cracks, shadows etc), barriers (walls, doors etc), questions (in an exam etc), commands, courses in a meal, steps in a process; (old) circuit (administrative division)

美.english: (bound form) the Americas (abbr. for 美洲[Mei3 zhou1]); (bound form) USA (abbr. for 美國|美国[Mei3 guo2]); beautiful; very satisfactory; good; to beautify; to be pleased with oneself

很.english: very; quite; (also, often used before an adjective without intensifying its meaning, i.e. as a meaningless syntactic element)

聯.english: (bound form) to ally oneself with; to unite; to combine; to join; (bound form) (poetry) antithetical couplet

最.english: (before an adjective or verb) to the highest degree; (the) most ...; -est; (after 之[zhi1]) best or most extreme example (e.g. 世界之最[shi4 jie4 zhi1 zui4] "the greatest in the world")

百.english: surname Bai; hundred; numerous; all kinds of

元.english: surname Yuan; Yuan dynasty (1279–1368); currency unit (esp. Chinese yuan); (bound form) first; original; primary; (bound form) basic; fundamental; (bound form) constituent; part; (prefix) meta-; (math.) argument; variable; era (of a reign); (Tw) (geology) eon

利.english: surname Li; sharp; favorable; advantage; benefit; profit; interest; to do good to; to benefit

定.english: to fix; to set; to make definite; to subscribe to (a newspaper etc); to book (tickets etc); to order (goods etc); to congeal; to coagulate; (literary) definitely

準.english: accurate; standard; definitely; certainly; about to become (bride, son-in-law etc); quasi-; para-

一.english: one; single; a (article); as soon as; entire; whole; all; throughout; "one" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 1); also pr. [yao1] for greater clarity when spelling out numbers digit by digit

波.english: (bound form) Poland (abbr. for 波蘭|波兰[Bo1 lan2]); surname Bo; wave; ripple; storm; surge

本.english: (bound form) root; stem; (bound form) origin; source; (bound form) one's own; this; (bound form) this; the current (year etc); (bound form) original; (bound form) inherent; originally; initially; capital; principal; classifier for books, periodicals, files etc

快.english: rapid; quick; speed; rate; soon; almost; to make haste; clever; sharp (of knives or wits); forthright; plainspoken; gratified; pleased; pleasant

們.english: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals

兩.english: two; both; some; a few; tael, unit of weight equal to 50 grams (modern) or 1⁄16 of a catty 斤[jin1] (old)

是.english: to be (followed by substantives only); correct; right; true; (respectful acknowledgement of a command) very well; (adverb for emphatic assertion)

停.english: to stop; to halt; to park (a car)

去.english: to go; to go to (a place); (of a time etc) last; just passed; to send; to remove; to get rid of; to reduce; to be apart from in space or time; to die (euphemism); to play (a part); (when used either before or after a verb) to go in order to do sth; (after a verb of motion indicates movement away from the speaker); (used after certain verbs to indicate detachment or separation)

息.english: (bound form) breath; (bound form) to cease; to stop; (bound form) to rest; (bound form) news; (bound form) interest (on money); (bound form) to grow; to multiply; (literary) one's child; Taiwan pr. [xi2]

高.english: surname Gao; high; tall; above average; loud; your (honorific)

到.english: to reach; to arrive; to leave for; to go to; to (a place); until (a time); up to (a point); (verb complement indicating arriving at a place or reaching a point); considerate; thoughtful; thorough

不.english: no; not so; (bound form) not; un-

星.english: star; heavenly body; satellite; small amount

經.english: surname Jing; classics; sacred book; scripture; to pass through; to undergo; to bear; to endure; warp (textile); longitude; menstruation; channel (TCM); abbr. for economics 經濟|经济[jing1 ji4]

家.english: home; family; (polite) my (sister, uncle etc); classifier for families or businesses; refers to the philosophical schools of pre-Han China; noun suffix for a specialist in some activity, such as a musician or revolutionary, corresponding to English -ist, -er, -ary or -ian; CL:個|个[ge4]

央.english: center; end; to beg; to plead

歐.english: Europe (abbr. for 歐洲|欧洲[Ou1 zhou1]); European Union (abbr. for 歐盟|欧盟[Ou1 meng2]); surname Ou; ohm (abbr. for 歐姆|欧姆[ou1 mu3]); euro (abbr. for 歐元|欧元[ou1 yuan2]); used in transliteration; old variant of 謀|讴[ou1]

期.english: a period of time; phase; stage; classifier for issues of a periodical, courses of study; time; term; period; to hope; Taiwan pr. [qi2]

位.english: position; location; place; seat; classifier for people (honorific); classifier for binary bits (e.g. 十六位 16-bit or 2 bytes); (physics) potential

決.english: to decide; to determine; to execute (sb); (of a dam etc) to breach or burst; definitely; certainly

頂.english: apex; crown of the head; top; roof; most; to carry on the head; to push to the top; to go against; to replace; to substitute; to be subjected to (an aerial bombing, hailstorm etc); (slang) to "bump" a forum thread to raise its profile; classifier for headwear, hats, veils etc

日.english: (bound form) sun; day; day of the month; (bound form) Japan (abbr. for 日本[Ri4 ben3]); (vulgar) to fuck; to have sex with

路.english: surname Lu; road (CL:條|条[tiao2]); journey; route; line (bus etc); sort; kind

月.english: moon; month; monthly; CL:個|个[ge4],輪|轮[lun2]

點.english: to touch briefly; to tap; to mark with a dot; to check off (on a list); to order (food etc); to select; to mention; to bring up (a topic or person); to hint at; to imply; to administer (eye medicine etc) in drops; to light (a fire, a lamp etc); to ignite; to nod (one's head) in agreement; to beckon by moving (one's hand) up and down; point; dot; spot; speck; dot stroke in Chinese characters; (math.) decimal point; point in time or space; (after a number) o'clock; a small amount; a bit; (after a verb or adjective) a bit more; classifier for small amounts

多.english: many; much; more; a lot of; too many; in excess; (after a numeral) ... odd; how (to what extent) (Taiwan pr. [duo2]); (bound form) multi-; poly-

學.english: to learn; to study; to imitate; science; -ology

認.english: to recognize; to know; to admit

國.english: surname Guo; country; nation; state; (bound form) national

成.english: surname Cheng; short name for Chengdu 成都[Cheng2 du1]; to succeed; to finish; to complete; to accomplish; to become; to turn into; to be all right; OK!; one tenth

布.english: cloth; to declare; to announce; to spread; to make known

社.english: (bound form) society; organization; agency; (old) god of the land

銀.english: silver; silver-colored; relating to money or currency

再.english: again; once more; re-; further; beyond this point of time; (before an adjective) more; then (after sth, and not until then); no matter how ... (followed by an adjective or verb, and then (usually) 亦[ye3] or 都[dou1] for emphasis); (used to introduce additional information, as in 再則|再则[zai4 ze2], 再就是[zai4 jiu4 shi4] etc); (literary) to reappear; to reoccur

管.english: surname Guan; to take care (of); to control; to manage; to be in charge of; to look after; to run; to care about; tube; pipe; woodwind; classifier for tube-shaped objects; particle similar to 把[ba3] in 管...叫 constructions; writing brush; (coll.) to; towards

在.english: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at; (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

之.english: (possessive particle, literary equivalent of 的[de5]); him; her; it

透.english: (bound form) to penetrate; to seep through; to tell secretly; to leak; thoroughly; through and through; to appear; to show

讓.english: to yield; to permit; to let sb do sth; to have sb do sth; to make sb (feel sad etc); by (indicates the agent in a passive clause, like 被[bei4])

物.english: (bound form) thing; (literary) the outside world as distinct from oneself; people other than oneself

能.english: surname Neng; can; to be able to; might possibly; ability; (physics) energy

公.english: public; collectively owned; common; international (e.g. high seas, metric system, calendar); make public; fair; just; Duke, highest of five orders of nobility 五等爵位[wu3 deng3 jue2 wei4]; honorable (gentlemen); father-in-law; male (animal)

百位.english: the hundreds place (or column) in the decimal system

停在.english: to stay at, to hold at

到頂.english: to reach the top, to peak
